notes: 2.5.2 - every region now has its own MINI BOSS with a unique model (Moss Warlord, Briar Colossus, Frost Alpha, Crystal Brute, Heartbound Reaper, Forgotten Sentinel); EPIC boss music (choir, taiko drums, crashes, build-ups, and the music speeds up in later phases) and new boss sound effects; a MUCH bigger Soul Tree (12 branches, 372 buffs); Soul Seeds are now rare - 1 to 3 per region. Achievements pay fewer seeds too.
